package.description: A package with its contract and only the sections it needs, its first record and its primitive.

feature.description: A feature with its gate, a screen, its route in the client app and its primitive.

command.description: A command in the package contract, with its server change and, when it shows at once, its local change.

record.description: A record in the package contract, and its table in repo/ when the package has one.

job.description: A job in jobs/, registered in the package and in the server app.

packages.description: Writes the app lists, packages.ts, from the packages that have runtime/client.ts or runtime/server.server.ts. Runs with nx sync.
